Rashi on Keritot 3b:10:1.hebrew: בעא מיניה ר' ירמיה [וכו'] מהו - אם עשאן בהעלם אחת, חייב אחת או ב'? מי מיחלקן כריתות לחטאות כלאוין, אי לא:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:10:1.english: Rabbi Yirmeya raised a dilemma before [Rabbi Zeira, etc.,] what is [the halakha] - If one performed them in a single lapse of awareness, is he liable [for] one [sin offering] or two? Do [multiple] punishments of karet divide [liability] into [separate] sin offerings like [multiple] prohibitions, or not?

Rashi on Keritot 3b:10:2.hebrew: שוחט ומעלה - איכא ב' כריתות באחרי מות, וחד לאו בראה אנכי: השמר לך פן תעלה עולותיך בכל מקום [וכו'. וכל מקום] שנאמר השמר, פן, ואל, אינו אלא לא תעשה. אבל בשחיטה ליכא לאו בהדיא, דהאי דכתיב בפרשת (ויקרא י״ז:ז׳) ולא יזבחו עוד את זבחיהם וגו', מוקים ליה בזבחים בפרק השוחט והמעלה (זבחים דף קו.) בזובח בהמה למרקוליס:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:10:2.english: One who slaughters and offers up - There are two [punishments of] karet in [the Torah portion of] Acharei Mot, and one prohibition in [the Torah portion of] Re'eh Anochi: "Take heed to yourself lest you offer up your burnt offerings in every place [etc.]." [And wherever] it says "take heed," "lest," or "do not," it is nothing other than a negative commandment. However, for slaughtering [outside the Temple], there is no explicit prohibition, for that which is written in the portion (Leviticus 17:7), "And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices, etc.," is established in Zevachim, in the chapter [entitled] Hashochet Vehama'aleh (Zevachim 106a), as [referring to] one who sacrifices an animal to Markulis:

Rashi on Keritot 3b:11:1.hebrew: ג"ש - התם בזבחים: בשחיטה נאמר הבאה, "ואל פתח אהל מועד לא הביאו", ובהעלאה נאמר (ויקרא י״ז:ט׳) "ואל פתח אהל מועד לא יביאנו". מה להלן בהעלאה ענש והזהיר:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:11:1.english: A verbal analogy - [This is explained] there in [Tractate] Zevachim: regarding slaughtering [outside the Temple], [an expression of] "bringing" is stated, "and to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he did not bring it," and regarding offering up, it is stated (Leviticus 17:9), "and to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he shall not bring it." Just as there, regarding offering up, [Scripture] punished and warned [so too here].

Rashi on Keritot 3b:13:1.english: And there you shall do - So too, [this refers to] one who slaughters.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:14:1.hebrew: אוב וידעוני - איכא ב' מיתות, דכתיב (ויקרא כ׳:כ״ז) אוב או ידעוני מות יומת, דאו מחלק, אי זו שיעשה ימות. ולאו אחד, דכתיב לא ימצא בך וגו' ושואל אוב וידעוני. ובני קרבן נינהו, דכתיב בהו כרת (שם) והנפש אשר תפנה אל האובות. וקמיבעי לך אי מיתות מחלקות לחטאות, והעושן בהעלם אחד חייב שתים, אי לא:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:14:1.english: A necromancer and a sorcerer - There are two death penalties [for these], as it is written (Leviticus 20:27): "a necromancer or a sorcerer shall surely be put to death," for [the word] "or" divides [them, teaching that] whichever one he does, he shall die. And [there is only] one negative prohibition, as it is written: "There shall not be found among you, etc., or a consulter of a necromancer or a sorcerer" [Deuteronomy 18:10–11]. And they are subject to a [sin] offering, for excision [karet] is written regarding them (there [Leviticus 20:6]): "And the soul that turns to the necromancers..." And it is a dilemma to you whether death penalties divide [transgressions] with respect to sin offerings — [such that] one who performs them in a single lapse of awareness is liable for two [sin offerings] — or not.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:15:1.hebrew: הא פלוגתא דר' יוחנן וריש לקיש - באלו הן הנסקלין בד' מיתות (סנהדרין דף סה.), דשמעינן דתרווייהו דאין חייבין עליהן אלא אחת, הואיל בלאו אחד נאמרו; הלכך, אין חילוק חטאות ביניהן. להכי לא חשיב אלא חד מינייהו, דכולהו כריתות דתנן במתני' למניינא דחטאות תננהו, כדאמרי' בריש פירקין: אם עשאן כולן בהעלם אחת, חייב על כל אחת ואחת:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:15:1.english: This is the dispute of Rabbi Yochanan and Reish Lakish - In [the section] Elu Hen HaNiskalin, in [the chapter] Arba Mitot (Sanhedrin 65a), where we learn regarding both of them [a necromancer and a sorcerer] that one is liable for only one [sin offering] for them, since they were stated in a single prohibition. Therefore, there is no division of sin offerings between them. For this reason, [the Tanna] counts only one of them, for all the [transgressions punishable by] karet that we learned in our Mishnah were taught for the count of sin offerings, as we say at the beginning of our chapter: "If one performed all of them in a single lapse of awareness, he is liable for each and every one."

Rashi on Keritot 3b:17:1.hebrew: הואיל ואין בו מעשה - הילכך לאו בר קרבן הוא, אבל אוב יש בו מעשה, שמנקש בזרועותיו ומדבר משחיו:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:17:1.english: Since it does not involve an action - Therefore, it is not subject to an offering, whereas [the transgression of] necromancy (ov) involves an action, for he knocks with his arms and speaks from his armpit.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:17:2.english: A yid'oni [diviner] inserts a bone of an animal whose name is yadua into his mouth, and it speaks.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:18:1.hebrew: דהא חלוקין הן במיתות - ואי לאו הטעם דלית ביה מעשה, מיתות מחלקן לחטאות, דהא חלוקין הן במיתות, וה"ל למיתנינהו אי הוה בר קרבן:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:18:1.english: Because they are divided with regard to death [penalties] - And were it not for the reason that it does not involve an action, [the] death [penalties] would divide them into [separate] sin offerings, because they are divided with regard to death [penalties], and [the Tanna] would have had to teach them if it were subject to an offering.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:19:1.hebrew: ר"ע היא דאמר - לקמן (כריתות דף ד.), מגדף מביא קרבן, דלא בעינן מעשה:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:19:1.english: It is Rabbi Akiva, who says - Below (Keritot 4a), [he states that] a blasphemer brings an offering, for we do not require an action.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:1:1.hebrew: אלא באומר מותר - לעבוד עבודת כוכבים, דהיינו שגגת עבודת כוכבים ושגגת עבודות:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:1:1.english: Rather, where one says [it is] permitted - To worship idols, which is unwittingness regarding idol worship and unwittingness regarding [the specific] forms of worship.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:1:2.hebrew: דעד כאן לא בעא מיניה רבא מר"נ - העלם זה וזה בידו מהו, בפ' ד' מיתות (סנהדרין סב.):
Rashi on Keritot 3b:1:2.english: As Rava raised a dilemma before Rav Naḥman only - "[If] unawareness of both this [the essence of Shabbat] and that [the specific forbidden labor] is in his hand, what [is the law]?" [This appears] in the chapter [entitled] Arba Mitot (Sanhedrin 62a).

Rashi on Keritot 3b:20:1.english: Although he does not require a significant action - [This is derived] from [the fact] that [the Mishnah] teaches [the case of] a blasphemer.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:22:1.hebrew: קס"ד - מדקאמר ר"ל הקשת זרועותיו הוי מעשה, וחזינן במתני' דפליגי רבנן אמגדף ולא פליגי אבעל אוב, ש"מ דאפי' לרבנן חשיב מעשה:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:22:1.english: It enters our mind - Since Reish Lakish said that the striking of his arms is an action, and we see in the Mishnah that the Rabbis disagree regarding a blasphemer and do not disagree regarding a necromancer, learn from this that even according to the Rabbis it is considered an action.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:26:1.hebrew: כרת דיליה - כרת דמגדף. מישתעי קרא בקרבן עבודת כוכבים בסדר שלח לך: "נפש כי תחטא בשגגה והקריבה עז בת שנתה וגו'", ובההיא פרשתא כתיב: "והנפש אשר תעשה ביד רמה וגו' ונכרתה", דמישתעי במגדף. וקסד"א: הואיל וכתיב במקום קרבן, ליחייב קרבן אע"ג דלית ביה מעשה, קמ"ל: "יצא מגדף":
Rashi on Keritot 3b:26:1.english: Its karet - [I.e.,] the karet of one who blasphemes. The verse speaks of an offering for idol worship in the Torah portion of Shelach Lecha: "A soul that sins unwittingly, and she shall offer a she-goat in its first year, etc."; and in that same section it is written: "And the soul that acts with a high hand, etc., shall be cut off," which speaks of one who blasphemes. And it might have entered your mind to say: since [its karet] is written in the place [discussing] an offering, one should be liable for an offering even though it involves no action; [therefore, the Mishnah] teaches us: "excluding one who blasphemes."

Rashi on Keritot 3b:27:1.hebrew: עולא אמר - היינו טעמא דלא פליגי רבנן אבעל אוב, דלאו בהקשת זרועותיו מיירי, אלא מקטר לשר השדים:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:27:1.english: Ulla said - This is the reason that the Rabbis do not disagree regarding a necromancer: because [the Mishnah] is not dealing with [the] knocking of his arms [together], rather [he] burns incense to the prince of the demons.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:27:2.hebrew: על מנת לחברו - שיתחבר אליו ויסייענו בכשפיו, ולא קיטר לו לשם אלוה:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:27:2.english: In order to join it [to him] - That it should join with him and assist him in his sorceries, and he did not burn incense to it as a deity.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:28:1.hebrew: היינו חובר חבר - ולא בכרת הוא, ולא במיתה הוא, אלא בלאו:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:28:1.english: This is a ḥover ḥever - And it is neither [subject] to karet, nor is it [subject] to death, but rather [it is only] a negative prohibition.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:28:2.english: A ḥover ḥever such as this - He is [one] who burns incense to the prince of the demons.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:29:1.english: One [who] gathers large [beasts] - Who gathers large beasts and joins them together.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:29:2.hebrew: חבר קטן - לחיות קטנות, לוחש ומחברן בכשפים יחד:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:29:2.english: A charmer of small [beasts] - For small beasts; he whispers [incantations] and joins them together through sorcery.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:29:3.hebrew: אפילו זיבורא ועקרבא - דלא חשיבי, אסור ללוחשן:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:29:3.english: Even a hornet and a scorpion - Which are not significant, it is forbidden to charm them.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:2:1.hebrew: רב פפא אמר משכחת לה בתינוק שנשבה לבין העובדי כוכבים - שגגת עבודת כוכבים וזדון עבודות, כגון שחזר ושמע שאותה עבודת כוכבים שישנה שם אסורה בד' עבודות הללו, והני עבודות הרוב ידעי דאסירן:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:2:1.english: Rav Pappa says: You find it in [the case of] a child who was taken captive among the idolaters - [This is a case of] unwittingness regarding the idol and intentionality regarding the acts of worship — such as where he later heard that that idol which is there is prohibited with these four acts of worship, and [as for] these acts of worship, most people know that they are prohibited.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:3:1.english: Unwitting with regard to idol worship - For he thinks there is no [prohibition of] idol worship of wood.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:4:1.hebrew: רב אחא בריה דרב איקא משמיה דרב ביבי אמר - לעולם זדון שבת ושגגת מלאכות נמי קחשיב, ודקאמרת ליחשיב טפי, תנא לא מהדר אלא על מצות שחייבין עליהן כרת:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:4:1.english: Rav Aḥa, son of Rav Ika, said in the name of Rav Beivai - In truth, [the tanna] also counts intentional [transgression of] Shabbat with unwitting [performance of] labors; and [as for] what you said, "Let him count more [cases]," the tanna is only concerned with [enumerating] commandments for which one is liable to karet.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:4:2.english: He teaches the category of Shabbat, he teaches the category of idol worship - And in fact, in each and every one [of them] there are many [cases].

Rashi on Keritot 3b:4:3.hebrew: והאיכא בתו מאנוסתו דלא כתיבא - אלא אתיא הנה הנה, אתיא זמה זמה, במסכת חגיגה בשילהי פ"ק (דף יא.):
Rashi on Keritot 3b:4:3.english: And is there [not] his daughter from a woman he raped, which is not written [explicitly in the Torah] - Rather, it is derived [from the words] "henah" [and] "henah," [and] derived [from the words] "zimah" [and] "zimah," in Tractate Chagigah at the end of the first chapter (11a).

Rashi on Keritot 3b:7:1.english: Rav Aḥa raises a contradiction - [one statement] of Rav Beivai against [another statement] of Rav Beivai.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:7:2.hebrew: והאיתמר - במס' זבחים בפ' השוחט (דף קז.):
Rashi on Keritot 3b:7:2.english: And wasn't it stated - In Tractate Zevachim, in the chapter [entitled] HaShochet (107a).

Rashi on Keritot 3b:7:3.english: Limbs of [an offering slaughtered] inside - [An animal] that was slaughtered in the [Temple] courtyard.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:7:4.english: Limbs of [an offering slaughtered] outside - A consecrated animal that was slaughtered outside [the Temple].

Rashi on Keritot 3b:8:1.hebrew: וקשיא ליה לרב ביבי - התם בזבחים, א"כ דתרי גווני העלאה איכא, ניתני בכריתות המעלה חוץ לעזרה אברי פנים, והמעלה נמי אברי חוץ:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:8:1.english: And Rav Beivai raised a difficulty - There, in [tractate] Zevachim, [he asked:] If so, that there are two types of offering up, let [the Tanna] teach in [tractate] Keritot: one who offers up outside the Temple courtyard limbs [of an offering slaughtered] inside, and also one who offers up limbs [of an offering slaughtered] outside.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:9:1.hebrew: מי דמי שבת - חשבון חיובי' תנא במס' שבת (דף עג.), ודעבודת כוכבים במס' סנהדרין (דף ס:):
Rashi on Keritot 3b:9:1.english: Are [they] comparable? Shabbat - [The tanna] taught the count of [its] liabilities in Tractate Shabbat (73a), and [that] of idol worship in Tractate Sanhedrin (60b).

Rashi on Keritot 3b:9:3.hebrew: וגבי כריתות דאיריא - הוא גררא בעלמא, דחשיב להו למצות שחייבין עליהן כרת, איכא לשנויי: שם שבת, שם עבודת כוכבים:
Rashi on Keritot 3b:9:3.english: And with regard to karet, where it is incidental [de'irya] - It is merely incidental, as [the tanna] is counting the commandments for which one is liable to karet; [therefore,] one can answer: [it teaches] the category of Shabbat, [and] the category of idol worship.

Rashi on Keritot 3b:9:4.english: But with regard to bringing up [an offering] - we do not find a place for it where the Mishnah teaches two types of bringing up.
